newsitem.title: USA: Printware Q4 sales rise with new processor.
newsitem.headline: Printware Q4 sales rise with new processor.

text.p: Printware Inc said Thursday its increase in revenues during the fourth quarter was a result of sales of a new image processor and an upturn in sales of one of its platesetters.
Earlier, the company reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.56 a share on revenues of $2.01 million versus $0.48 on sales of $1.87 million.
Net income for the quarter included a $0.17 a share income tax benefit. Printware said it will recognize additional further income tax benefits, assuming continued profitability.
In fourth quarter 1995, the company recorded a $0.05 a share gain on an arbitration award.

"The fourth quarter revenue increase compared to 1995 was primarily due to sales of a newly-completed raster image processor which satisfied pent-up demand, the beginning of shipments of raster image processors to Deluxe Corp, and an upward trend in Mitsubishi-branded platesetter sales," the company said in a statement.
